critical_code_review_comments: control_phase3.py is 656 lines — under the 700-line guideline. It cleanly separates Marketing/Content/Categories/Billing/Webhook/DB-viewer/AI/Backups/Exports/Impersonation and is easy to extend.

Financial-integrity contract holds: LIVE mode returns configured=false, kpis all null, empty subscriptions/payments and refund endpoint 400 with 'not configured'. DEMO records are all flagged is_demo_data=true. No fabricated LIVE financial numbers anywhere.
Webhook scaffold (/api/webhooks/payments) is intentionally no-auth (providers can't send bearer tokens) and correctly logs+ignores until a provider is attached — good.
DB Viewer whitelist + hashed_password/file_base64 redaction + db_viewed audit entry are all wired correctly and enforced at the endpoint layer.
Impersonation issues a JWT with 'imp' claim and 30-min expiry; server-side get_current_user tags the user with _impersonated_by which is then honoured by DELETE /users/me (403). Solid.

Backup restore correctly runs mongorestore --drop which will replace the DB — the 428 reauth gate is the only barrier, so admins should be reminded (UI copy) how destructive it is. Currently the gate is respected.
